name: How long does home sale preparation painting take?

mainEntity.name: How long does home sale preparation painting take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of home sale preparation painting depends on the scope of work. A single room might be completed in 1-2 days, while an entire interior can take 3-7 days. Exterior painting generally takes longer, ranging from 5 days to 2 weeks, depending on the home's size, weather conditions, and prep work required. Factors such as extensive repairs, multiple coats, and intricate trim can extend timelines. Discuss realistic timelines with your contractor, especially if you have a tight schedule for listing your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting duration varies: 1-2 days for a room, 3-7 days for interiors, and 5 days to 2 weeks for exteriors, depending on project scope.
